results.reply:

If you need treatment after the test, common options include:
• P-Alaxin tablets (9-tab course) for **23,000 UGX**
• Lonart tablets for **21,000 UGX**
• Children's P-Alaxin syrup 60ml for **1,500 UGX**

We recommend visiting LMMC for proper testing and consultation. Your clinician will determine the right treatment and dosage.

results.name: english-only
results.input: What services do you offer?
results.reply:
At Lynda Michelle Medical Centre, we offer a range of healthcare services to meet your needs:

• **Outpatient Care (OPD):** General consultations and treatment  
• **Maternal & Reproductive Health:** Antenatal care (ANC), deliveries, family planning  
• **Laboratory & Diagnostics:** Tests for malaria, HIV, syphilis, pregnancy, blood sugar, and more  
• **Immunization:** Vaccinations for children and adults as per national schedule  
• **Pharmacy:** Wide selection of 178 drugs available  
• **Minor Surgery:** Wound care, suturing, abscess drainage  
• **Community Health Education:** Outreach programs to promote health awareness  
• **Home-Based Care:** Visits for elderly and homebound patients  

If you want details on any specific service or pricing, just ask!

results.name: luganda-only
results.input: Mpeereza ki ze mulina?
results.reply:
Tukola eby’enjawulo ku Lynda Michelle Medical Centre, eby’okuyamba abalwadde mu ngeri ez’enjawulo:

• **Outpatient Care (OPD):** Okusaba omusawo, okusuzibwa, n’okuwandiika eddagala, ku bbeeyi ya 10,000-15,000 UGX.

• **Maternal & Reproductive Health:** ANC (okuwandiisa omwana), okubeera omuyungu, family planning (Lydia pills 3,000 UGX/month, Injectable 5,000 UGX/3 months, Implanon 20,000 UGX, n’ebirala).

• **Laboratory & Diagnostics:** Okukola ebisanyizo nga malaria RDT 5,000 UGX, HIV 5,000 UGX, syphilis 5,000 UGX, pregnancy (HCG) 2,000 UGX, blood sugar 5,000 UGX.

• **Immunization:** Okutereeza abaana n’abantu abakulu ku pulogulaamu ya Ministry of Health.

• **Pharmacy:** Ddagala 178 mu stock, nga Paracetamol 250 UGX/tab, Amoxicillin 200 UGX/cap, n’ebirala.

• **Minor Surgery:** Okutereeza ebizibu eby’amaanyi, okuddamu okuzimba, n’okukola abscess drainage.

• **Community Health Education:** Okuyamba abantu mu by’obulamu mu bitundu.

• **Home-Based Care:** Okusaba obuyambi ku bantu abali mu maka.

Tewelalikiriza, tujja kuyamba. Osobola okutubuuza ku bbeeyi oba obulamu bwo.
